“要是有袋化肥就好了。”

许默盯着脚下这块隐隐发黑的土地。

永恒领域里的物资极度匮乏，这可都是上好的发酵材料，以后弄到种子，没点它们根本种不活。

污物处理完毕，两人迅速折返。

许默一把捞起角落里的十个藤编捕鸟筐，方芸则用宽树叶包起一包带血的碎肉末。

两人一前一后，踩着泥泞，顺着庇护所东北侧径直向森林边缘摸去。

方芸看过来的眼神有点奇怪。

不过许默理解，毕竟一对男女吃喝拉撒每天都在一块。

刚才方芸还亲眼看着他堆肥。

庇护所周围的天然废料，也不是没有方芸自己的贡献......

那眼神能好了就怪了。

雨后的密林透着股森冷。

距离拉开，每隔几百米，许默便寻一处隐蔽的灌木丛，熟练地扣下一个藤筐，支起木棍机关。方芸则将腥气扑鼻的碎肉末小心翼翼地撒在筐下。

十个笼子，形成一张暗藏杀机的大网，铺进了这片荒野。

诱饵布下，接下来的重头戏是石材。

升级庇护所需要整整一百单位的石材，材料缺口逼着他们榨干最后一点体力。

本来石料最多的地方就是山洞里面。

但庇护所的建立，直接改变地形，山洞不复存在。

敢挖一下庇护所周围的石头，你看看扣不扣你耐久度就完事了。

许默掂了掂手里的石斧，目光锁定在一棵碗口粗细的橡树上。

方芸也毫不含糊，走到相隔不远的另一棵树旁。

“笃！”

“笃！笃！”

沉闷的伐木声在幽暗的林间此起彼伏，木屑四下飞溅。

高强度的体力消耗让许默刚才练出的酸痛感再次复苏，但他咬紧牙关，抡斧的动作没有丝毫停顿。

猛地，一声极其突兀的动静撕裂了伐木的节奏。

"It would be nice if I had a bag of fertilizer."

Xu Mo stared at the faintly black land beneath his feet.

Materials are extremely scarce in the Eternal Realm. These are all good fermentation materials. If you get the seeds in the future, you won’t be able to plant them without them.

After finishing handling the dirt, the two quickly turned back.

Xu Mo picked up ten rattan bird baskets in the corner, while Fang Yun wrapped a bag of bloody minced meat in broad leaves.

The two of them walked in the mud, one behind the other, along the northeast side of the shelter and headed straight towards the edge of the forest.

Fang Yun looked over with a strange look.

But Xu Mo understood, after all, a man and a woman eat, drink, and have sex together every day.

Just now, Fang Yun watched him compost with her own eyes.

The natural waste around the shelter is not without Fang Yun’s own contribution...

It's strange that his eyes are getting better.

The dense forest feels cold after the rain.

As the distance increased, every few hundred meters, Xu Mo found a hidden bush, skillfully pulled down a rattan basket and set up a wooden stick mechanism.Fang Yun carefully scattered the fishy minced meat under the basket.

Ten cages formed a large network of hidden murderous intentions, spreading into this wilderness.

The bait is laid, and the next big thing is the stone.

Upgrading the shelter required a hundred units of stone, and the material gap forced them to squeeze out the last bit of their strength.

Originally, the place with the most stones was inside the cave.

But the establishment of the shelter directly changed the terrain, and the cave no longer existed.

If you dare to dig up the rocks around the shelter, you can see if it deducts your durability.

Xu Mo weighed the stone ax in his hand and fixed his gaze on an oak tree as thick as a bowl.

Fang Yun was unambiguous and walked to another tree not far away.

"Tuk!"

"Tuk! Tuk!"

The dull sound of logging came one after another in the dark forest, and sawdust flew everywhere.

The high-intensity physical exertion revived the soreness Xu Mo had just practiced, but he gritted his teeth and swung the ax without any pause.

Suddenly, an extremely sudden sound broke the rhythm of logging.
